data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate accepted the Reinsurance to Close (RITC) of the 2014 year of account (which included the 2007 and 2011 years of account of Syndicates 1208 and 102 respectively) into its 2017 year of account. The report notes that the 2012, 2013, and 2014 years of account remained open at 31 December 2016 due to uncertainties from historic volatility in the liability book, suggesting potential adverse development. However, no specific quantified prior year reserve movement (release or strengthening) is disclosed in the financial statements or notes. The claims development triangle is distorted by the RITC, making it unsuitable for calculating prior year development.
raw_causal_phrases: uncertainties over the final loss arising from a combination of factors, the main factor being the continuing assessment of the reserving position due to historic volatility experienced in the liability book.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit prior year development figure (gross or net) was found. The claims development triangle is distorted by the Reinsurance to Close (RITC) of the 2014 year of account (including 2007 and 2011) into the 2017 year of account, making it unsuitable for calculating prior year development. Gross premium mix includes a negative amount for 'Reinsurance' and 'Accident and health' which represents return premiums or cancellations.
